purpose: taxids for 20 names by qualified label ("Name <qualifier>"), batch 4
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> SELECT ?t ?l WHERE { ?t rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t),'NCBITaxon_[0-9]+$')) FILTER(REGEX(STR(?l), "^(Drosophila|Nematoda|Lophotrochozoa|Mollusca|Gastropoda|Annelida|Platyhelminthes|Cnidaria|Hydrozoa|Porifera|Echinodermata|Danio rerio|Oryzias latipes|Xenopus laevis|Drosophila melanogaster|Canis lupus familiaris|Exocoetus volitans|Hirundichthys speculiger|Cypselurus hiraii|Hirundichthys affinis) <[^>]*>$")) }
